mapper.select: SELECT ddps.id, shares.dates, shares.pkg, shares.user_source, shares.invitation_num, shares.fill_code_num, shares.total_user_num, ddps.create_time, ddps.update_time from (SELECT dusr.dates, dusr.pkg, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Organic') user_source, count(CASE dusr.source WHEN 1 THEN dusr.source END) invitation_num, count(CASE dusr.source WHEN 0 THEN dusr.source END) fill_code_num, COUNT(1) total_user_num FROM dwd_user_share_record dusr left join dim_user_source dus on (dusr.user_id = dus.user_id) WHERE dusr.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY dusr.dates, dusr.pkg, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Organic')) shares LEFT JOIN dws_daily_pkg_usrc_share ddps on (ddps.dates = shares.dates and ddps.pkg = shares.pkg and ddps.user_source = shares.user_source)
